nodes.title: CONTROL PANEL
code:
SHMUP V - CONTROL PANEL
Every setting of the game in one place (F9 = Creator view). Each row edits the node it names; change a value and rebuild (F5).

ENEMIES are not settings here: open the WORLD map and press E. Place them with L-click, delete with R-click; each TYPE sets its frame, colour, movement, speed, HP, points and pickup drop.

nodes.title: STARTUP
code: Begin at SYSTEM INIT. Bank out BASIC, then jump to the title screen.

nodes.title: EXPLOSIONS / SFX
code: Advance short explosions. Play effects on voice 3. Tick SFX once per frame.

nodes.title: FIXED HUD / RASTER
code: IRQ selects HUD scroll. Next IRQ resumes world. Callbacks return via RTS.

nodes.title: HUD VALUES
code: Convert score to digits. Write lives and score. The HUD stays still.

nodes.title: GAME SETUP
code: Choose VIC and charset. Set scrolling and actors. Install the fixed HUD.

nodes.title: SPRITE ANIMATION
code: Set VIC sprite registers. Enemy frame + colour come from their spawn type.

nodes.title: COLLISIONS / LIVES
code: Test shots and enemies. SPN_Hit takes their HP. Score their type points.

nodes.title: PROJECTILE
code: Move the shot upward. Retire it off screen. Hits are checked next.

nodes.title: ATTACK WAVES
code: Enemies sit on the WORLD map (open it, press E). The SPAWNER flies them.

nodes.title: BOOT / TITLE
code: Show the bitmap menu. Play menu music. Fire starts the game.

nodes.title: JOYSTICK / FIRE
code: Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.

nodes.title: RESPAWN
code: Reset the player state. Clear shots and enemies. Relaunch what is in view.

nodes.title: FRAME LOOP
code: Run gameplay once/frame. Wait for bottom border. Draw actors, then scroll.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; EXPLOSIONS / SFX
; Advance short explosions. Play effects on voice 3. Tick SFX once per frame.

; SilenceGame
; Continue the routine around the neighbouring Dev Machine macro.

SilenceGame:
LDA #$00
STA $D404
STA $D40B

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; FIXED HUD / RASTER
; IRQ selects HUD scroll. Next IRQ resumes world. Callbacks return via RTS.
; State used here:
;   $D011: VIC vertical mode and fine scroll
;   $D016: VIC horizontal mode and fine scroll

; HudFixed
; Raster callbacks keep the HUD steady while the playfield scrolls.

; Use fixed fine-scroll values for the top HUD.
HudFixed:
LDA #$18
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
RTS

; Restore the scrolling playfield after the HUD raster split.
HudPlayfield:
; LDA $0063 - keep original absolute encoding and timing.
.byte $AD,$63,$00
ORA #$10
STA $D011
LDA #$18
STA $D016
RTS

HudNmi:
RTI

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; HUD VALUES
; Convert score to digits. Write lives and score. The HUD stays still.
; State used here:
;   $C008: lives

; Status
; Write the current score and lives to the fixed HUD.

Status:
LDA $C008
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0440
LDA $C007
CLC
ADC #$31
STA $044A
LDA $C00F
LDX #$30

ScoreTens:
CMP #$0A
BCC ScoreReady
SEC
SBC #$0A
INX
JMP ScoreTens

ScoreReady:
CLC
ADC #$30
STA $0432
STX $0431
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; STARTUP
; Begin at SYSTEM INIT. Bank out BASIC, then jump to the title screen.
; State used here:
;   $D011: VIC vertical mode and fine scroll
;   $D016: VIC horizontal mode and fine scroll

; InstallHudSplit
; Continue the routine around the neighbouring Dev Machine macro.
LDA #$36
STA $01
JMP BootTitle

InstallHudSplit:
SEI
LDA #$7F
STA $DC0D
STA $DD0D
LDA $DC0D
LDA $DD0D
LDA #<HudNmi
STA $FFFA
LDA #>HudNmi
STA $FFFB
LDA #$1B
STA $D011
LDA #$08
STA $D016
LDA #$35
STA $01

nodes.title: DRAW ACTORS
code:
; SPRITE ANIMATION
; Set VIC sprite registers. Fade enemies on entry. Show explosion frames.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; DrawActors
; Write sprite positions and pointers, including the user-made entry fade.

; Convert gameplay state into VIC sprite positions, colours and pointers.
; Player ship colour - exposed on the SHIP COLOUR panel.
SHIP_COL = $01

DrawActors:
LDA $C000
STA $D000
LDA $C001
STA $D001
LDA $C005
STA $D004
LDA $C006
STA $D005
LDA #$A5
STA $07FA
LDA #$C1
STA $C01A
LDA $C044
BEQ DrawPlayerAlive
STA $C047
LDA #$18
SEC
SBC $C047
LSR
LSR
LSR
CLC
ADC #$A6
STA $07F8
LDA #$07
STA $D027
JMP DrawEnemies

; Select the normal player sprite when no explosion is running.
DrawPlayerAlive:
LDA #SHIP_COL
STA $D027
LDA $C00D
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$03
CMP #$03
BNE PlayerFrameReady
LDA #$01

PlayerFrameReady:
CLC
ADC #$A0
STA $07F8

; Each slot (sprites 1, 3, 4 and 5) shows its live enemy - the type's
; FRAME and COLOUR from the WORLD map's SPAWN layer - or else its
; explosion. Exposed on the CONTROL PANEL: with ENTRY_FADE on, an enemy
; above Y=88 shows the frame after its type's frame (keep each enemy's
; fade-in frame right after it in ACTORS).
ENTRY_FADE = 1

DrawEnemies:
LDA #$00
STA $C06F
LDX #$03

DrawEnemyLoop:
LDA SPN_ON,X
BNE DrawEnemyLive
LDA $C040,X
BNE DrawEnemyBoom
JMP DrawEnemyNext

; Explosion frames $A6 up, where the enemy went down.
DrawEnemyBoom:
STA $C047
LDA #$18
SEC
SBC $C047
LSR
LSR
LSR
CLC
ADC #$A6
LDY EnemySprite,X
STA $07F8,Y
LDA #$07
STA $D027,Y
LDA $C020,X
STA $C045
LDA $C02C,X
STA $C046
LDA $C024,X
JMP DrawEnemyPut

; A live enemy: its type's frame (+1 while fading in) and colour.
DrawEnemyLive:
LDY SPN_TYPE,X
LDA SPN_T_COL,Y
STA $C047
LDA SPN_T_PTR,Y
.IF ENTRY_FADE == 1
LDY SPN_Y,X
CPY #$58
BCS DrawEnemyFull
CLC
ADC #$01
.ENDIF
DrawEnemyFull:
LDY EnemySprite,X
STA $07F8,Y
LDA $C047
STA $D027,Y
LDA SPN_XL,X
STA $C045
LDA SPN_XH,X
STA $C046
LDA SPN_Y,X

; A = Y, $C045 / $C046 = the 9-bit X. Place the sprite, switch it on.
DrawEnemyPut:
LDY EnemyPos,X
STA $D001,Y
LDA $C045
STA $D000,Y
LDA $C01A
ORA EnemyBit,X
STA $C01A
LDA $C046
BEQ DrawEnemyNext
LDA $C06F
ORA EnemyBit,X
STA $C06F

DrawEnemyNext:
DEX
BMI DrawShot
JMP DrawEnemyLoop

DrawShot:
DrawNext3:
LDA $C004
BEQ DrawPickup
LDA $C01A
ORA #$04
STA $C01A

; A pickup borrows its enemy slot's sprite once that slot's explosion ends.
; Slot 0 is sprite 1; slots 1-3 are sprites 3-5.
DrawPickup:
LDA $C060
BEQ EnableActors
LDY $C061
LDA SPN_ON,Y
ORA $C040,Y
BNE EnableActors
TYA
BNE PickupSprHigh
LDA #$01
BNE PickupSprReady
PickupSprHigh:
CLC
ADC #$02
PickupSprReady:
STA $C06C
TAX
LDA #$AA
STA $07F8,X
LDA $C00D
LSR
LSR
AND #$07
ORA #$08
STA $D027,X
TXA
ASL
TAX
LDA $C062
STA $D000,X
LDA $C063
STA $D001,X
; Enable bit = 1 shifted left by the sprite number.
LDX $C06C
LDA #$01
PickupBitShift:
DEX
BMI PickupBitDone
ASL
JMP PickupBitShift
PickupBitDone:
TAY
LDA $C065
BEQ PickupLowX
TYA
ORA $C06F
STA $C06F
PickupLowX:
TYA
ORA $C01A
STA $C01A

; Write the assembled enable mask once all sprite slots are prepared.
; $D010 holds the ninth X bits: sprite 7 (HUD), player (0), shot (2)
; and the enemies / pickup ($C06F).
EnableActors:
LDA #$80
ORA $C06F
LDX $C066
BEQ NinthNoPlayer
ORA #$01
NinthNoPlayer:
LDX $C067
BEQ NinthNoShot
ORA #$04
NinthNoShot:
STA $D010
LDA $C01A
STA $D015
RTS

; Enemy slot -> its hardware sprite, X register offset and enable bit.
EnemySprite:
.byte $01,$03,$04,$05
EnemyPos:
.byte $02,$06,$08,$0A
EnemyBit:
.byte $02,$08,$10,$20

nodes.title: HITS
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES
; Test shots and enemies. Update score and lives. Start explosion effects.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; Hits
; Resolve hits, score and lives; start the matching explosion effect.

; A hit changes game state and starts effects; drawing happens later.
; New state (inside GAME_STATE, $C000-$C07F):
;   $C020/$C02C/$C024: where each slot's enemy went down (its explosion)
;   $C060: pickup active   $C061: pickup slot   $C062/$C063: pickup X/Y
;   $C065: pickup X ninth bit
;   $C064: next pickup type (0 speed, 1 shot, 2 life)
;   $C066: player X ninth bit   $C067: shot X ninth bit
;   $C068: speed-ups collected  $C069: shot boost collected
;   $C06A: ship step this frame
;   $C070-$C075: wall probe scratch (see Walls; pointer in $FB/$FC)
;   $C06C/$C06D: 16-bit scratch $C06E: shot step this frame

; Exposed on the RULES panel.
WALLS_KILL = 1       ; 1 = flying into a wall-tagged char destroys the ship
DROPS = 1            ; 1 = spawn types with a DROP leave a pickup

Hits:
LDA $C044
BEQ HitsAlive
RTS

HitsAlive:
LDA $C009
BEQ HitsWalls
DEC $C009
JMP HitsStart

; Walls come from the tag system: WallCheck (Walls block) looks up the
; chars under the ship in the TILES tags, so stars never count.
HitsWalls:
.IF WALLS_KILL == 1
JSR WallCheck
BEQ HitsStart
JMP WallCrash
.ENDIF

HitsStart:
LDX #$00

; Check each active enemy against the player and the single shot.
HitLoop:
LDA SPN_ON,X
BNE HitActive
JMP HitNext

HitActive:
LDA $C009
BNE CheckShotHit
; 16-bit player X against the enemy's 9-bit X: |dx| < 15.
LDA $C000
SEC
SBC SPN_XL,X
STA $C06C
LDA $C066
SBC SPN_XH,X
STA $C06D
LDA $C06C
CLC
ADC #$0F
STA $C06C
LDA $C06D
ADC #$00
BNE CheckShotHit
LDA $C06C
CMP #$1E
BCS CheckShotHit
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC SPN_Y,X
CLC
ADC #$0D
CMP #$1A
BCS CheckShotHit
JSR Damage
RTS

; Only an active projectile can score a hit.
CheckShotHit:
LDA $C004
BEQ HitNext
; 16-bit shot X against the enemy's 9-bit X: |dx| < 9.
LDA $C005
SEC
SBC SPN_XL,X
STA $C06C
LDA $C067
SBC SPN_XH,X
STA $C06D
LDA $C06C
CLC
ADC #$09
STA $C06C
LDA $C06D
ADC #$00
BNE HitNext
LDA $C06C
CMP #$12
BCS HitNext
LDA $C006
SEC
SBC SPN_Y,X
CLC
ADC #$0C
CMP #$18
BCS HitNext
; The shot is spent; the hit takes one of the enemy's HP (its spawn
; type's HP). Carry clear = it survived.
LDA #$00
STA $C004
LDA #$01
JSR SPN_Hit
BCC HitNext
JSR EnemyDown
.IF DROPS == 1
; A type with a DROP leaves a pickup where it died (one at a time).
LDY SPN_TYPE,X
LDA SPN_T_DROP,Y
BEQ HitNext
LDA $C060
BNE HitNext
LDA #$01
STA $C060
STX $C061
LDA $C020,X
STA $C062
LDA $C02C,X
STA $C065
LDA $C024,X
STA $C063
.ENDIF

HitNext:
INX
CPX #$04
BEQ HitsDone
JMP HitLoop

HitsDone:
RTS

; EnemyDown - X = slot. The explosion takes the enemy's place ($C020 /
; $C02C / $C024 keep where it died) and its type's POINTS are scored.
EnemyDown:
LDA SPN_XL,X
STA $C020,X
LDA SPN_XH,X
STA $C02C,X
LDA SPN_Y,X
STA $C024,X
LDA #$18
STA $C040,X
LDY SPN_TYPE,X
LDA SPN_T_PTS,Y
CLC
ADC $C00F
CMP #$64
BCC EnemyScore
LDA #$63
EnemyScore:
STA $C00F
JMP ExplosionSound

; Lose a life and start the player burst before allowing a respawn.
Damage:
LDA #$18
STA $C044
LDA #$FF             ; ramming destroys the enemy outright
JSR SPN_Hit
JSR EnemyDown
LDA #$00
STA $C004
DEC $C008
BNE DamageDone
LDA #$03
STA $C008
LDA #$00
STA $C00F

DamageDone:
RTS

; Hitting a wall: same burst and life loss as a collision, no enemy involved.
WallCrash:
LDA #$18
STA $C044
LDA #$00
STA $C004
JSR ExplosionSound
DEC $C008
BNE WallCrashDone
LDA #$03
STA $C008
LDA #$00
STA $C00F

WallCrashDone:
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; FRAME LOOP
; Run gameplay once/frame. Wait for bottom border. Draw actors, then scroll.

; GameLoop
; Update gameplay before the border wait, then prepare sprites and scroll.

; One pass is one game frame. Keep heavy work outside visible scrolling.
GameLoop:
JSR SfxTick
JSR Effects
JSR Input
JSR Enemy
JSR Shot
JSR Hits
JSR Pickups
JSR Status

nodes.title: SHOT
code:
; PROJECTILE
; Move the shot upward. Retire it off screen. Hits are checked next.
; State used here:
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C006: shot Y

; Shot
; Advance the player shot and retire it beyond the playfield.

; Pixels the shot climbs per frame - exposed on the WEAPON panel.
SHOT_SPEED = $04

Shot:
LDA $C004
BEQ ShotDone
LDA #SHOT_SPEED
CLC
ADC $C069
STA $C06E
LDA $C006
SEC
SBC $C06E
STA $C006
CMP #$4E
BCS ShotDone
LDA #$00
STA $C004

ShotDone:
RTS

nodes.title: JOYSTICK
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE
; Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C044: player explosion timer

; Ship speed in pixels per frame - exposed on the SHIP panel.
SHIP_SPEED = 2

; A bursting player cannot move or fire.
Input:
LDA $C044
BEQ InputAlive
RTS
InputAlive:
; Ship step = panel speed + collected speed-ups.
LDA #SHIP_SPEED
CLC
ADC $C068
STA $C06A
; Save the previous position for movement/collision work.
LDA $C000
STA $C010
LDA $C001
STA $C011

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; RESPAWN
; Reset the player state. Clear shots. Relaunch the on-screen enemies.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; ResetActors
; Reset the player, projectiles and enemy state for a fresh life.

; A new life begins with a centred ship and no active projectile.
ResetActors:
LDA #$00
STA $C044
LDX #$03

; Clear every explosion timer so old effects cannot survive a respawn.
ClearExplosions:
STA $C040,X
DEX
BPL ClearExplosions
LDA #$90
STA $C000
LDA #$C8
STA $C001
LDA #$00
STA $C004
STA $C005
STA $C006
STA $C060
STA $C066
STA $C067
STA $C068
STA $C069
STA $C00A
STA $C00B
STA $C065
; The SPAWNER clears its slots and relaunches what is on screen.
JSR SPN_Reset
LDA #$64
STA $C009
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; BOOT / TITLE
; Show the bitmap menu. Play menu music. Fire starts the game.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C008: lives

; BootTitle
; Display the bitmap menu; music runs only here. Fire begins the game.

BootTitle:
SEI
CLD
LDA #$36
; STA $0001 - keep original absolute encoding and timing.
.byte $8D,$01,$00
LDA #$00
LDX #$7F

ClearState:
STA $C000,X
DEX
BPL ClearState
LDA #$03
STA $C008
LDA #$00
STA $DC02
LDA #$FF
STA $DC00

nodes.title: WALLS
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES
; Wall test using the tag system. Chars are tagged in the TILES charset
; (tileset editor: ALT+click / right-click a char to set its tag T1-T16).
; METASCROLL emits those tags as WORLD_TILE_TYPES: [char, tag] pairs, $FF ends.
; The wall chars of the canyon are tagged T1; the stars are untagged.

; Exposed on the RULES panel: which tag means "wall".
WALL_TAG = 1

; Probe three points of the ship (left wing, right wing, nose).
; Returns A = 1 (Z clear) when any of them sits on a WALL_TAG char.
WallCheck:
LDA #$04
STA $C070
LDA #$0F
STA $C071
JSR WallProbe
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ WallYes
LDA #$13
STA $C070
JSR WallProbe
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ WallYes
LDA #$0B
STA $C070
LDA #$05
STA $C071
JSR WallProbe
CMP #WALL_TAG
BEQ WallYes
LDA #$00
RTS
WallYes:
LDA #$01
RTS

; Shared "nothing here" exit, kept above WallProbe so every branch reaches it.
ProbeNone:
LDA #$00
RTS

; WallProbe: $C070/$C071 = x/y offset into the ship sprite.
; Finds the screen char under that point (fine scroll included) and
; returns its tag in A (0 = untagged or off screen).
WallProbe:
; column = (ship X + x offset - 24 - XSCROLL) / 8, 16-bit for the ninth bit
LDA $D016
AND #$07
STA $C072
LDA $C000
CLC
ADC $C070
STA $C06C
LDA $C066
ADC #$00
STA $C06D
LDA $C06C
SEC
SBC #$18
STA $C06C
LDA $C06D
SBC #$00
STA $C06D
LDA $C06C
SEC
SBC $C072
STA $C06C
LDA $C06D
SBC #$00
BMI ProbeNone
LSR
ROR $C06C
LSR
ROR $C06C
LSR
ROR $C06C
LDA $C06C
CMP #$28
BCS ProbeNone
STA $C073

; row = (ship Y + y offset - 48 - YSCROLL) / 8
LDA $D011
AND #$07
STA $C072
LDA $C001
CLC
ADC $C071
SEC
SBC #$30
BCC ProbeNone
SEC
SBC $C072
BCC ProbeNone
LSR
LSR
LSR
CMP #$19
BCS ProbeNone
STA $C074

; $FB/$FC = $0400 + row * 40 + column
ASL
ASL
ASL
STA $FB
LDA #$00
STA $FC
LDA $FB
ASL
ROL $FC
ASL
ROL $FC
CLC
ADC $FB
STA $FB
LDA $FC
ADC #$04
STA $FC
LDA $FB
CLC
ADC $C073
STA $FB
LDA $FC
ADC #$00
STA $FC
LDY #$00
LDA ($FB),Y
STA $C075

; Look the char up in the tag table.
LDY #$00
ProbeScan:
LDA WORLD_TILE_TYPES,Y
CMP #$FF
BEQ ProbeEnd
CMP $C075
BEQ ProbeTag
INY
INY
BNE ProbeScan
ProbeEnd:
LDA #$00
RTS

ProbeTag:
INY
LDA WORLD_TILE_TYPES,Y
RTS

nodes.title: ENEMY FLIGHT
code:
; ATTACK WAVES
; The SPAWNER above launches the enemies placed on the WORLD map's SPAWN
; layer (open WORLD, press E) as the scroll brings them into view, and
; flies each one by its type: frame, colour, movement, speed, HP,
; points and drop are all set per type in that editor.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X   $C066: its ninth bit   $C001: player Y
;   $C00D: animation clock

; Enemy
; Tell the SPAWNER where the ship is (CHASE and DIVE home in on
; SPN_TGT), then let it launch and move its four slots.
Enemy:
INC $C00D
LDA $C000
STA SPN_TGT_XL
LDA $C066
STA SPN_TGT_XH
LDA $C001
STA SPN_TGT_Y
JSR SPN_Update
; Return through the explicit RTS node directly below this code block.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; FRAME LOOP
; Run gameplay once/frame. Wait for bottom border. Draw actors, then scroll.

; ScrollFlight
; Continue the routine around the neighbouring Dev Machine macro.
JSR DrawActors
; LDA $0061 - keep original absolute encoding and timing.
.byte $AD,$61,$00
BNE ScrollFlight
LDA #$20
; STA $0061 - keep original absolute encoding and timing.
.byte $8D,$61,$00
; The map looped: count it on the HUD (the WAVE digit), up to 9.
LDA $C007
CMP #$08
BCS ScrollFlight
INC $C007

; The world moves one pixel down: TURRET and WALKER entities move with it.
ScrollFlight:
JSR SPN_Scroll
JSR MSC_U
JSR MSC_Update
JMP GameLoop

nodes.title: PICKUPS
code:
; COLLISIONS / LIVES
; Pickups drop from enemies whose spawn type has a DROP. Each one is the next of
; SPEED UP, SHOT UP and EXTRA LIFE in turn. Lost on death.
; State: $C060-$C064, $C068, $C069 (see Hits).

; Exposed on the RULES panel.
MAX_SPEEDUPS = 2     ; extra pixels per frame the ship can collect
MAX_SHOTUPS = 4      ; extra pixels per frame the shot can collect

Pickups:
LDA $C060
BNE PickupLive
RTS
PickupLive:
LDY $C061
LDA $C040,Y
BEQ PickupMove
RTS
PickupMove:

; Drift down one pixel every other frame; gone past the bottom.
LDA $C00D
AND #$01
BEQ PickupCatch
INC $C063
LDA $C063
CMP #$E8
BCC PickupCatch
LDA #$00
STA $C060
RTS

; Collect on contact (16-bit player X): |dx| < 16, |dy| < 18.
PickupCatch:
LDA $C044
BEQ PickupTouch
RTS
PickupTouch:
LDA $C000
SEC
SBC $C062
STA $C06C
LDA $C066
SBC $C065
STA $C06D
LDA $C06C
CLC
ADC #$10
STA $C06C
LDA $C06D
ADC #$00
BNE PickupMiss
LDA $C06C
CMP #$20
BCS PickupMiss
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC $C063
CLC
ADC #$12
CMP #$24
BCC PickupGot
PickupMiss:
RTS

PickupGot:
LDA #$00
STA $C060
JSR FireSound
LDA $C064
BEQ PickupSpeed
CMP #$01
BEQ PickupShot

; Extra life, up to the 9 the HUD digit can show.
LDA $C008
CMP #$09
BCS PickupNext
INC $C008
JMP PickupNext

PickupSpeed:
LDA $C068
CMP #MAX_SPEEDUPS
BCS PickupNext
INC $C068
JMP PickupNext

PickupShot:
LDA $C069
CMP #MAX_SHOTUPS
BCS PickupNext
INC $C069
INC $C069

; Rotate SPEED UP -> SHOT UP -> EXTRA LIFE.
PickupNext:
INC $C064
LDA $C064
CMP #$03
BCC PickupsDone
LDA #$00
STA $C064

PickupsDone:
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE
; Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X
;   $C001: player Y
;   $C004: shot active flag
;   $C005: shot X
;   $C006: shot Y

; $F8 is the active-low joystick sample stored by the JOYSTICK macro.
; $C00B is an edge latch: hold fire without retriggering the sound.
LDA $F8
STA $C00C
; Fire is tested after movement, including diagonal movement.
LDA $F8
AND #$10
BNE FireReleased
LDA $C00B
BNE InputDone
LDA #$01
STA $C00B
LDA $C004
BNE InputDone
LDA #$01
STA $C004
LDA $C000
CLC
ADC #$00
STA $C005
LDA $C066
STA $C067
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC #$08
STA $C006
JSR FireSound
RTS

; Clear the latch so the next press can fire again.
FireReleased:
LDA #$00
STA $C00B

; Return to the caller after processing the current input.
InputDone:
RTS

; Advance short explosions. Play effects on voice 3. Tick SFX once per frame.
; State used here:

;   $C044: player explosion timer

; Effects
; Advance explosion animation and sound effects without restarting music.
RTS

Effects:

EffectEnemy:
LDA $C040,X
BEQ EffectNext
DEC $C040,X

DEX
BPL EffectEnemy
LDA $C044

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE
; Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X (low)
;   $C066: player X ninth bit

; X is 16-bit: $C000 low byte, $C066 ninth bit, so the ship reaches the
; whole screen. The step comes from Input ($C06A). Walls are deadly now,
; so the limit is just the left edge of the visible screen.
; The joystick macro calls this label; RTS returns to its dispatcher.
X_MIN = $18

LDA $C000
SEC
SBC $C06A
STA $C000
LDA $C066
SBC #$00
STA $C066
BMI JoyLeftClamp
BNE JoyLeftDone
LDA $C000
CMP #X_MIN
BCS JoyLeftDone
JoyLeftClamp:
LDA #X_MIN
STA $C000
LDA #$00
STA $C066
JoyLeftDone:
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; JOYSTICK / FIRE
; Port 2 selects callbacks. Diagonals combine moves. Fire uses an edge latch.
; State used here:
;   $C000: player X (low)
;   $C066: player X ninth bit

; X is 16-bit: $C000 low byte, $C066 ninth bit. Right limit is $140
; (ninth bit set, low byte X_MAX_LO), the right edge of the screen.
; The joystick macro calls this label; RTS returns to its dispatcher.
X_MAX_LO = $40

LDA $C000
CLC
ADC $C06A
STA $C000
LDA $C066
ADC #$00
STA $C066
BEQ JoyRightDone
LDA $C000
CMP #X_MAX_LO
BCC JoyRightDone
LDA #X_MAX_LO
STA $C000
JoyRightDone:
RTS
